title: React Router
description: Learn client-side routing with React Router for single-page applications.
longDescription: Single-page applications need navigation without full page reloads. This module covers React Router fundamentals: route definitions, nested layouts, dynamic parameters, programmatic navigation, and protected routes for authenticated experiences.
whatYouLearn: Install and configure react-router-dom for client-side navigation
Define routes and handle 404 pages with catch-all paths
Build nested layouts using Outlet and index routes
Extract dynamic segments and query parameters from URLs
Navigate programmatically and protect routes with authentication checks
